query: Freshly-installed template fails at CLIPLoader: 'size mismatch for Llama2 state_dict' (Qwen3-shaped 2560-hidden weights loaded into a Llama arch) — hits a wave of users on older ComfyUI builds that can't load the new text-encoder weights.

desired.outcome: Fix per affected users (not OP/maintainer): fully update the ComfyUI backend+frontend — diverHansun confirmed updating to latest solved it, seanntxj fixed it by force-updating via command line instead of ComfyUI-Manager (one user still broken on 0.3.76 after Manager update). diverHansun links the official comfyui-wiki update guide.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
